# Lucas Oliveira — olivmath

> Senior Blockchain Engineer & Cryptography Specialist

## About

Lucas Bispo de Oliveira (olivmath) is a Senior Blockchain Engineer based in Florianópolis, SC, Brazil, with 6+ years of experience architecting, building, and securing blockchain systems.

## Current Roles

- Principal Blockchain Engineer at DREX (Brazil's Central Bank Digital Currency — CBDC)
- Head of Education at NearX (8000+ students trained in blockchain)
- Official Stellar Ambassador for Brazil

## Key Projects

- **DREX**: Principal Engineer on Brazil's CBDC project. Smart contract architecture and privacy infrastructure with ZKP on Hyperledger Besu.
- **Merkly**: Most-used Python library for Merkle Trees in blockchain. 55k+ downloads on PyPI. Open source at github.com/olivmath/merkly.
- **Lunes L1 Protocol**: Tech Lead developing a token-centric L1 protocol. Achieved 83% sync time reduction.
- **PostGraduation Program**: Created and leads the blockchain postgrad program at NearX, training 8000+ students across Latin America.

## Technical Expertise

- Languages: Rust, Solidity, Python, Scala, TypeScript
- Domains: Smart Contracts, Zero Knowledge Proofs, CBDC, DeFi, Merkle Trees, Cryptography
- Protocols: Ethereum, Stellar/Soroban, XRPL, Hyperledger Besu, Chiliz
